# Digital Signage AI · digitalsignage.ai (MCP hub)

> Machine entry point. digitalsignage.ai is the ENGLISH, white-label edition of the
> Admira Xperience platform (Spanish edition: admira.tv). One platform, twenty
> connected solutions for physical spaces. Humans: https://www.digitalsignage.ai/help/

Public site:  https://www.digitalsignage.ai/
MCP hub:      https://www.digitalsignage.ai/mcp/
Manifest:     https://www.digitalsignage.ai/mcp/manifest.json
Solutions:    https://www.digitalsignage.ai/data-solutions.json
Version:      v.23.08.2026.r1.19:22
Repo:         https://github.com/csilvasantin/digitalsignage-ai

## What this is

The same platform as admira.tv, in English, with the brand as a runtime value rather
than a baked-in string. A partner can operate the whole catalogue under their own name.

Brand switching: `?brand=neutral` (default) or `?brand=admira`. The registry lives in
`/brand.js`; brand strings are carried in `data-brand-*` attributes, never inside copy,
so a switch cannot half-apply.

## The twenty solutions

- **Dashboard** — Brings performance, content and results together in one clear view.
- **Digital Signage** — Plans and publishes content across one screen or a complete network.
- **Content Catalogue** — Organises creative assets and campaigns for fast reuse and distribution.
- **Support** — Centralises help, tracking and resolution to keep every experience available.
- **Push Notifications** — Triggers relevant notifications for teams and audiences at the right time.
- **Virtual Assistant** — Answers questions, guides visitors and supports tasks through natural conversation.
- **Ad Stack** — Connects targeting, inventory and ad activation to make every screen work harder.
- **Gamification** — Turns interactions into challenges and rewards that increase engagement and recall.
- **IoT Manager** — Connects screens, players and sensors so the space works as one system.
- **Video Analytics** — Measures aggregated attention and behaviour to improve content and spaces.
- **Radio Analytics** — Estimates footfall through anonymous signals to reveal visit patterns.
- **Social WiFi** — Provides guest connectivity and turns each consented access into a useful relationship.
- **Queue Manager** — Organises turns and waiting times for smoother, more predictable service.
- **Room Booking** — Makes available spaces easy to find and book without friction or double allocation.
- **Audio Branding** — Builds a consistent sonic identity for every moment of the experience.
- **Olfactory Marketing** — Uses scent as a brand channel to create recognisable, memorable environments.
- **Virtual Reality** — Creates immersive ways to explore products, stories and impossible spaces.
- **Augmented Reality** — Layers digital information and interaction over products and physical environments.
- **Digital Twins** — Represents the space as a digital twin connecting content, context and operations.
- **Team Building** — Turns team collaboration into a shared, AI-powered experience.

Machine-readable source of the list: `/data-solutions.json` — the same file that
generates the page, with `slug`, `icon`, `name_es`, `name_en`, `description_es`,
`description_en` and `status` for each entry. Bilingual by construction.

## What this host does NOT have

No API and no state. It is a catalogue and a brand shell. Operational data lives in the
Admira stack (proof-of-play and audience at `https://api.admira.store`, see
`https://www.clearchannel.tv/mcp/`).
